scope: Eighteen EXISTING canonical debates; five Catholic-side focal assertions each (90). Each scoped source-to-claim unit has original document and exact section, bilingual source stage snapshot, and a context boundary. These 90 do not constitute complete sentence-by-sentence certification of the full stages.
primary_documents_read: Vatican Pius XII original Italian 29 Oct 1951 obstetricians address on matrimonial right, use and serious motives
Aquinas I-II qq18,19; II-II q154; Supplement q64 via New Advent
explicit_limits: Doctrinal-source citation proves the normative principle, not every factual example or opposing author's views.
Passages are inspected as original-text web pages, not original manuscript editions; Latin/Italian where directly available, otherwise the Vatican's official English text.
Stage records contain paraphrased focal claims, not comprehensive sentence-by-sentence verification; 0 full debate certifications.
No claim of expert theological or native French independent approval.

claims.atomic_claim: Consent is morally necessary but does not exhaust the goodness of a chosen act
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Aquinas and the encyclical analyze acts; examples of commercial exploitation need separate sociological evidence.
claims.stage_live_en: Consent is necessary. Without it, the injustice can be severe.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le consentement est nécessaire. Sans lui, l’injustice peut être grave.

claims.atomic_claim: Voluntary agreement does not by itself change an act's object
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Aquinas and the encyclical analyze acts; examples of commercial exploitation need separate sociological evidence.
claims.stage_live_en: Consent is necessary, but agreement does not by itself make the chosen act just. Two consenting persons can betray an existing spouse, exploit vulnerability, or agree to something contrary to a serious duty. The moral object and obligations remain relevant (Veritatis Splendor §§78–80).
claims.stage_live_fr: Le consentement est nécessaire, mais l’accord ne rend pas à lui seul l’acte choisi juste. Deux personnes consentantes peuvent trahir un conjoint, exploiter une vulnérabilité ou convenir de quelque chose de contraire à un devoir grave. L’objet moral et les obligations demeurent déterminants (Veritatis Splendor, §§78–80).

claims.atomic_claim: Chosen adultery may remain wrong despite mutual consent
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Aquinas and the encyclical analyze acts; examples of commercial exploitation need separate sociological evidence.
claims.stage_live_en: Two people can consent to adultery, to an exploitative commercial arrangement, or to conduct that violates a prior promise. Catholic ethics therefore asks two questions: Was it freely chosen? And what exactly was chosen?
claims.stage_live_fr: Deux personnes peuvent consentir à l’adultère, à un arrangement commercial exploiteur ou à une conduite qui viole une promesse antérieure. La morale catholique pose donc deux questions : l’acte a-t-il été librement choisi ? Et qu’a-t-on exactement choisi ?

claims.atomic_claim: Natural moral goods are not all created by personal agreement
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Aquinas and the encyclical analyze acts; examples of commercial exploitation need separate sociological evidence.
claims.stage_live_en: Then the dispute moves from consent to the nature of sexual union itself: whether sexual acts have goods and meanings that are not created solely by agreement. Catholicism says they do, especially through their relation to marriage and generation.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le débat se déplace alors du consentement vers la nature même de l’union sexuelle : les actes sexuels ont-ils des biens et des significations qui ne sont pas créés uniquement par l’accord ? Le catholicisme répond oui, notamment en raison de leur rapport au mariage et à la génération.

claims.atomic_claim: Consent is necessary but not a sufficient morality test
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Aquinas and the encyclical analyze acts; examples of commercial exploitation need separate sociological evidence.
claims.stage_live_en: Consent is indispensable, but it cannot make every chosen act good. It answers who chose; it does not by itself answer whether the choice was good.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le consentement est indispensable, mais il ne peut rendre bon tout acte choisi. Il répond à la question de savoir qui a choisi ; il ne suffit pas à dire si le choix était bon.

claims.atomic_claim: A good end is one ingredient of moral analysis
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The stages are applications of moral action theory, not quotations describing specific contemporary sexual acts.
claims.stage_live_en: Catholic morality fully agrees that intention is one essential part of a human act and can increase or lessen responsibility.
claims.stage_live_fr: La morale catholique reconnaît pleinement que l’intention est une dimension essentielle de l’acte humain et peut augmenter ou diminuer la responsabilité.

claims.atomic_claim: Good intentions cannot change every chosen means
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The stages are applications of moral action theory, not quotations describing specific contemporary sexual acts.
claims.stage_live_en: The error is making intention the only source of moral goodness. A good end does not automatically make the chosen means good.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’erreur consiste à faire de l’intention l’unique source de bonté morale. Une bonne fin ne rend pas automatiquement bon le moyen choisi.

claims.atomic_claim: Object, end and circumstances must all be examined
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The stages are applications of moral action theory, not quotations describing specific contemporary sexual acts.
claims.stage_live_en: The tradition distinguishes the object chosen, the further intention and the circumstances. A person can sincerely seek a good end and still choose a means that contradicts another serious good.
claims.stage_live_fr: La tradition distingue l’objet choisi, l’intention ultérieure et les circonstances. Une personne peut sincèrement rechercher une bonne fin tout en choisissant un moyen qui contredit un autre bien grave.

claims.atomic_claim: A desired good can be sought by conflicting means
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The stages are applications of moral action theory, not quotations describing specific contemporary sexual acts.
claims.stage_live_en: They are connected but not identical. The same desired end can be pursued by different means, and moral reasoning routinely distinguishes between them. Wanting to save a relationship, avoid pregnancy or relieve distress does not tell us which act was chosen to achieve that end.
claims.stage_live_fr: Ils sont liés mais non identiques. La même fin désirée peut être poursuivie par des moyens différents, et le raisonnement moral les distingue constamment. Vouloir sauver une relation, éviter une grossesse ou soulager une détresse ne dit pas quel acte a été choisi pour y parvenir.

claims.atomic_claim: A sincere ultimate goal does not render every means good
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The stages are applications of moral action theory, not quotations describing specific contemporary sexual acts.
claims.stage_live_en: Good intentions matter greatly, but they do not erase the moral character of the means deliberately chosen.
claims.stage_live_fr: Les bonnes intentions comptent beaucoup, mais elles n’effacent pas le caractère moral des moyens délibérément choisis.

claims.atomic_claim: Personal circumstances and knowledge affect culpability
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Veritatis Splendor argues objective norms; it is not an examination of Fletcher's entire original opposition corpus.
claims.stage_live_en: Catholic morality agrees that circumstances and culpability can radically change how responsible a person is.
claims.stage_live_fr: La morale catholique reconnaît que les circonstances et la culpabilité peuvent modifier radicalement la responsabilité d’une personne.

claims.atomic_claim: A proportionate loving aim cannot render every moral object good
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Veritatis Splendor argues objective norms; it is not an examination of Fletcher's entire original opposition corpus.
claims.stage_live_en: Fletcher correctly notes that circumstances affect the morality of choices; his stronger claim that love can override every negative precept is incompatible with intrinsically evil acts. Veritatis Splendor §§79–81 locates their wrongness in the object freely chosen, not in a failure to calculate the most loving result.
claims.stage_live_fr: Fletcher relève à juste titre que les circonstances comptent dans les choix ; mais l’idée que l’amour puisse écarter toute interdiction morale contredit l’existence d’actes intrinsèquement mauvais. Veritatis Splendor (§§79–81) situe leur malice dans l’objet librement choisi, non dans l’absence d’un calcul du résultat le plus aimant.

claims.atomic_claim: Intrinsic wrongness classifies a chosen object, not uniform personal guilt
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Veritatis Splendor argues objective norms; it is not an examination of Fletcher's entire original opposition corpus.
claims.stage_live_en: An intrinsically evil act is one whose chosen object is incompatible with the good of the person in every case. The doctrine concerns the act’s moral species, not a claim that every person who commits it is equally guilty.
claims.stage_live_fr: Un acte intrinsèquement mauvais est un acte dont l’objet choisi est incompatible avec le bien de la personne dans tous les cas. La doctrine concerne l’espèce morale de l’acte, non l’affirmation que toute personne qui le commet est également coupable.

claims.atomic_claim: The label intrinsic evil requires a defensible specification of the moral object
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Veritatis Splendor argues objective norms; it is not an examination of Fletcher's entire original opposition corpus.
claims.stage_live_en: Only if no argument is offered for why the object is always incompatible with the good. The real work is identifying the moral object correctly and showing why it cannot be ordered to a good end. “Intrinsic evil” is the conclusion of that analysis, not a substitute for it.
claims.stage_live_fr: Seulement si aucun argument n’est donné pour montrer pourquoi l’objet est toujours incompatible avec le bien. Le vrai travail consiste à identifier correctement l’objet moral et à montrer pourquoi il ne peut être ordonné à une bonne fin. « Intrinsèquement mauvais » est la conclusion de l’analyse, non son substitut.

claims.atomic_claim: An absolute act norm and individual guilt are separate claims
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Veritatis Splendor argues objective norms; it is not an examination of Fletcher's entire original opposition corpus.
claims.stage_live_en: Absolute norms do not deny complexity. They distinguish the objective character of a choice from the often much more complex question of personal culpability.
claims.stage_live_fr: Les normes absolues ne nient pas la complexité. Elles distinguent le caractère objectif d’un choix de la question, souvent bien plus complexe, de la culpabilité personnelle.

claims.atomic_claim: Conscience binds even where mistaken
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The specific Donum Veritatis instruction is directed to theologians; wider lay conscientious obligation requires other moral sources.
claims.stage_live_en: A person should not deliberately act against a certain judgment of conscience.
claims.stage_live_fr: Une personne ne doit pas agir délibérément contre un jugement certain de conscience.

claims.atomic_claim: Conscience is not a private doctrinal teaching office
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The specific Donum Veritatis instruction is directed to theologians; wider lay conscientious obligation requires other moral sources.
claims.stage_live_en: Conscience obliges a person to avoid what he judges evil, but it does not create the truth of the act. A mistaken judgment remains possible, and even a sincere theologian's difficulty with non-irreformable teaching does not confer independent doctrinal authority on private conscience (Aquinas I–II q.19 aa.5–6; Donum Veritatis §28).
claims.stage_live_fr: La conscience oblige à éviter ce que l’on juge mauvais, mais elle ne crée pas la vérité de l’acte. Un jugement erroné demeure possible, et même la difficulté sincère d’un théologien devant un enseignement non irréformable ne confère pas à sa conscience une autorité doctrinale autonome (saint Thomas, I–II, q.19, a.5–6 ; Donum Veritatis, §28).

claims.atomic_claim: Conscience must be formed with objective sources and moral truth
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The specific Donum Veritatis instruction is directed to theologians; wider lay conscientious obligation requires other moral sources.
claims.stage_live_en: Catholic teaching therefore joins two duties: follow conscience and form conscience. Formation includes seeking evidence, understanding authoritative teaching, examining motives and remaining willing to correct an error.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’enseignement catholique unit donc deux devoirs : suivre sa conscience et former sa conscience. Cette formation comprend la recherche des preuves, la compréhension de l’enseignement autoritatif, l’examen des motifs et la disposition à corriger une erreur.

claims.atomic_claim: Donum Veritatis addresses conscientious difficulty for theologians specifically
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The specific Donum Veritatis instruction is directed to theologians; wider lay conscientious obligation requires other moral sources.
claims.stage_live_en: Donum Veritatis §§28–30 addresses theologians who have serious difficulties with non-irreformable teaching: it demands patient inquiry, loyalty to the Magisterium and readiness to revise their views. The instruction does not turn private conscience into an alternative teaching authority. Every Catholic must seek to form conscience truthfully rather than treat sincere disagreement as permission to disregard a moral norm.
claims.stage_live_fr: Donum Veritatis (§§28–30) traite des théologiens éprouvant de sérieuses difficultés devant un enseignement non irréformable : il demande une recherche patiente, la fidélité au Magistère et la disponibilité à réviser leurs conclusions. Ce texte ne fait pas de la conscience privée une autorité doctrinale parallèle. Tout catholique doit former sa conscience dans la vérité et ne peut tenir un désaccord sincère pour une permission de méconnaître une norme morale.

claims.atomic_claim: Neither private infallibility nor thoughtless rejection of moral truth follows
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The specific Donum Veritatis instruction is directed to theologians; wider lay conscientious obligation requires other moral sources.
claims.stage_live_en: Conscience binds, but conscience can err. The Catholic task is neither blind obedience nor private infallibility, but sincere judgment disciplined by truth.
claims.stage_live_fr: La conscience oblige, mais elle peut se tromper. La tâche catholique n’est ni l’obéissance aveugle ni l’infaillibilité privée, mais un jugement sincère discipliné par la vérité.

claims.atomic_claim: Some non-irreformable teaching can cause genuine theological difficulty
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Do not imply that every non-definitive act has equal authority or that theological difficulty erases ecclesial obedience.
claims.stage_live_en: There are genuine open questions in Catholic theology, and expert disagreement can be evidence that a matter is not settled.
claims.stage_live_fr: Il existe de véritables questions ouvertes en théologie catholique, et le désaccord d’experts peut indiquer qu’une question n’est pas tranchée.

claims.atomic_claim: A consensus of dissent does not replace the Magisterium
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Do not imply that every non-definitive act has equal authority or that theological difficulty erases ecclesial obedience.
claims.stage_live_en: The existence of dissent is not a measure of doctrinal authority. Even non-definitive authentic teaching calls for religious submission appropriate to its status, and the number of dissenting theologians does not itself free the faithful to disregard it (Donum Veritatis §§23–28).
claims.stage_live_fr: L’existence de dissensions n’est pas une mesure de l’autorité doctrinale. Même un enseignement authentique non définitif demande l’adhésion religieuse qui correspond à son statut ; le nombre de théologiens dissidents ne dispense pas à lui seul les fidèles d’en tenir compte (Donum Veritatis, §§23–28).

claims.atomic_claim: Authentic teaching and unsettled school opinions have different authority
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Do not imply that every non-definitive act has equal authority or that theological difficulty erases ecclesial obedience.
claims.stage_live_en: Catholic theology distinguishes disputed questions from authoritative moral teaching. Donum Veritatis explicitly allows serious difficulty and further inquiry while rejecting the idea that the Magisterium is merely one opinion among competing schools.
claims.stage_live_fr: La théologie catholique distingue les questions disputées de l’enseignement moral autoritatif. Donum Veritatis reconnaît la possibilité de difficultés sérieuses et de recherches ultérieures tout en rejetant l’idée que le Magistère soit simplement une opinion parmi des écoles concurrentes.

claims.atomic_claim: Disciplined inquiry and loyal dialogue are required when difficulty persists
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Do not imply that every non-definitive act has equal authority or that theological difficulty erases ecclesial obedience.
claims.stage_live_en: Where a teaching is genuinely non-irreformable, serious difficulties can warrant disciplined examination; they do not create an automatic permission to contradict the teaching. Donum Veritatis §§28–31 demands an honest search for resolution, loyalty to the Magisterium and avoidance of treating theologians as a competing authority.
claims.stage_live_fr: Lorsqu’un enseignement n’est réellement pas irréformable, des difficultés sérieuses peuvent justifier un examen rigoureux ; elles ne donnent pas automatiquement la permission de contredire l’enseignement. Donum Veritatis (§§28–31) demande une recherche loyale de solution, la fidélité au magistère et le refus de substituer une autorité théologique concurrente.

claims.atomic_claim: Numbers of dissenters cannot by themselves establish an open question
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Do not imply that every non-definitive act has equal authority or that theological difficulty erases ecclesial obedience.
claims.stage_live_en: The number of dissenting theologians does not settle the issue. First determine whether the question is actually open and what authority the disputed teaching possesses.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le nombre de théologiens dissidents ne tranche pas la question. Il faut d’abord déterminer si la matière est réellement ouverte et quelle autorité possède l’enseignement contesté.

claims.atomic_claim: A serious engagement can manifest genuine love
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Canonical form is not absolute: extraordinary form and dispensation exist; the record makes no judgment on an individual wedding's validity.
claims.stage_live_en: A loving engaged couple possesses genuine goods that a casual sexual relationship may lack.
claims.stage_live_fr: Un couple fiancé et aimant possède de véritables biens qu’une relation sexuelle occasionnelle peut ne pas avoir.

claims.atomic_claim: Intention to marry later does not produce a present marriage
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Canonical form is not absolute: extraordinary form and dispensation exist; the record makes no judgment on an individual wedding's validity.
claims.stage_live_en: The missing step is the claim that intention to marry already creates marriage. It does not create the public, exclusive and binding covenant or its present rights and duties.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’étape manquante est l’idée que l’intention de se marier crée déjà le mariage. Elle ne crée ni l’alliance publique, exclusive et obligatoire, ni ses droits et devoirs présents.

claims.atomic_claim: Matrimonial consent creates marriage; canonical form normally applies with exceptions
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Canonical form is not absolute: extraordinary form and dispensation exist; the record makes no judgment on an individual wedding's validity.
claims.stage_live_en: Matrimonial consent establishes a present marriage, not merely a promise to marry later (CIC can. 1057). Catholics ordinarily must also observe canonical form (can. 1108), subject to exceptions and dispensations established by law (including cann. 1116 and 1127 §2). A sincere, exclusive engagement is not yet the matrimonial covenant and does not itself confer conjugal rights.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le consentement matrimonial établit le mariage présent, et non une simple promesse de se marier plus tard (CIC, can. 1057). Les catholiques doivent normalement observer la forme canonique (can. 1108), sous réserve des exceptions et dispenses prévues par le droit (notamment cann. 1116 et 1127 §2). Des fiançailles sincères et exclusives ne constituent pas encore l'alliance matrimoniale et ne confèrent pas, à elles seules, les droits conjugaux.

claims.atomic_claim: Changing fertility probability does not establish conjugal rights before marriage
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Canonical form is not absolute: extraordinary form and dispensation exist; the record makes no judgment on an individual wedding's validity.
claims.stage_live_en: That argument assumes contraception changes the moral meaning of sex rather than merely reducing the likelihood of conception. Catholicism rejects that premise: intercourse remains the kind of act naturally connected to generation and therefore to stable parental responsibility.
claims.stage_live_fr: Cet argument suppose que la contraception change la signification morale de la sexualité au lieu de simplement réduire la probabilité de conception. Le catholicisme rejette cette prémisse : l’union demeure le type d’acte naturellement lié à la génération et donc à une responsabilité parentale stable.

claims.atomic_claim: An engaged couple cannot treat future matrimony as a present legal bond
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Canonical form is not absolute: extraordinary form and dispensation exist; the record makes no judgment on an individual wedding's validity.
claims.stage_live_en: Love matters, but love alone does not create marriage. The Catholic claim is that sexual union belongs to the covenant that makes permanent fidelity and parenthood its objective framework.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’amour compte, mais l’amour seul ne crée pas le mariage. L’affirmation catholique est que l’union sexuelle appartient à l’alliance qui fait de la fidélité permanente et de la parentalité son cadre objectif.

claims.atomic_claim: Sterility by itself does not annul marriage
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Canons identify impediments but do not alone prove every contested claim about the nature of marriage; can.1098 is not automatic nullity.
claims.stage_live_en: Actual fertility is not required for a valid marriage, and infertility can occur through age or pathology without fault.
claims.stage_live_fr: La fécondité effective n’est pas requise pour la validité du mariage, et l’infertilité peut résulter de l’âge ou d’une pathologie sans faute.

claims.atomic_claim: Failure to conceive differs from canonical incapacity to consummate
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Canons identify impediments but do not alone prove every contested claim about the nature of marriage; can.1098 is not automatic nullity.
claims.stage_live_en: Not producing a child is not equivalent to not being the kind of union ordered to generation; those are different claims.
claims.stage_live_fr: Ne pas produire d’enfant n’équivaut pas à ne pas être le type d’union ordonné à la génération ; ce sont deux affirmations différentes.

claims.atomic_claim: Can.1084 §3 reserves the can.1098 deceit proviso, and §2 covers doubt
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Canons identify impediments but do not alone prove every contested claim about the nature of marriage; can.1098 is not automatic nullity.
claims.stage_live_en: Canon 1084 §3 states that sterility neither prohibits nor invalidates marriage, but expressly preserves the separate rule on fraud affecting consent in canon 1098. Canon 1084 §1 addresses antecedent and perpetual impotence, while §2 protects marriages where the alleged impediment is doubtful. The capacity for the conjugal kind of union and successful conception are distinct juridical questions; these canons alone do not supply the whole philosophical argument.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le canon 1084 §3 affirme que la stérilité n'empêche ni n'invalide le mariage, mais réserve expressément la règle distincte du canon 1098 sur le dol affectant le consentement. Le §1 du canon 1084 vise l'impuissance antécédente et perpétuelle, tandis que le §2 protège le mariage lorsque cet empêchement est douteux. La capacité d'union conjugale et la réussite de la conception sont deux questions juridiques distinctes ; ces canons ne fournissent pas, à eux seuls, tout l'argument philosophique.

claims.atomic_claim: Infertility does not settle every philosophical account of marital union
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Canons identify impediments but do not alone prove every contested claim about the nature of marriage; can.1098 is not automatic nullity.
claims.stage_live_en: Only if no account is given of why the distinction matters. The Catholic account points to the bodily complementarity of the act and its natural relation to generation, independent of whether that relation succeeds in each instance.
claims.stage_live_fr: Seulement si aucune raison n’est donnée pour expliquer pourquoi la distinction compte. L’explication catholique invoque la complémentarité corporelle de l’acte et son rapport naturel à la génération, indépendamment du fait que ce rapport aboutisse dans chaque cas.

claims.atomic_claim: The outcome/impotence distinction must preserve the fraud exception
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Canons identify impediments but do not alone prove every contested claim about the nature of marriage; can.1098 is not automatic nullity.
claims.stage_live_en: Infertility concerns outcome; the marriage argument concerns the structure of the union. Confusing those two produces the apparent inconsistency.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’infertilité concerne le résultat ; l’argument sur le mariage concerne la structure de l’union. Confondre les deux produit l’apparente incohérence.

claims.atomic_claim: Catholic marriage includes real mutual affection and help
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Casti preserves its historical language about matrimonial ends; later magisterial discussions must be reconciled instead of silently made identical.
claims.stage_live_en: Catholic teaching strongly affirms mutual love, help, sanctification and companionship.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’enseignement catholique affirme fortement l’amour mutuel, l’aide, la sanctification et la compagnie.

claims.atomic_claim: The generative good and spousal love need not be opposed
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Casti preserves its historical language about matrimonial ends; later magisterial discussions must be reconciled instead of silently made identical.
claims.stage_live_en: The false choice is between personal love and procreation. Catholic marriage includes both rather than reducing marriage to either one.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le faux dilemme oppose l’amour personnel et la procréation. Le mariage catholique inclut les deux au lieu de réduire le mariage à l’un ou l’autre.

claims.atomic_claim: Casti retains an ordered treatment of procreation, fidelity and personal perfection
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Casti preserves its historical language about matrimonial ends; later magisterial discussions must be reconciled instead of silently made identical.
claims.stage_live_en: Casti Connubii §§11–17 treats offspring and their education as a principal good of marriage; §§19–25 addresses fidelity, spousal love, mutual help and growth in virtue. The encyclical's historical ordering of matrimonial ends should not be silently flattened into a claim that every end has the same place. Nor does this ordering mean an infertile marriage lacks genuine love or validity (CIC can. 1084 §3).
claims.stage_live_fr: Casti Connubii (§§11–17) traite de la procréation et de l'éducation des enfants comme d'un bien principal du mariage ; les §§19–25 abordent la fidélité, l'amour conjugal, l'entraide et la croissance dans la vertu. Il ne faut pas effacer tacitement l'ordre traditionnel des fins du mariage en affirmant qu'elles occupent toutes la même place. Cet ordre ne signifie pas non plus qu'un mariage stérile manque d'amour véritable ou de validité (CIC, can. 1084 §3).

claims.atomic_claim: Childlessness by itself does not make marriage invalid
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Casti preserves its historical language about matrimonial ends; later magisterial discussions must be reconciled instead of silently made identical.
claims.stage_live_en: Yes. Lack of children does not make a marriage unreal or loveless. The claim is not that every marriage must achieve every good, but that the institution itself is ordered to goods larger than companionship alone.
claims.stage_live_fr: Oui. L’absence d’enfants ne rend pas un mariage irréel ou sans amour. L’affirmation n’est pas que chaque mariage doit réaliser tous les biens, mais que l’institution elle-même est ordonnée à des biens plus larges que la seule compagnie.

claims.atomic_claim: The inherited ranking of ends must not be flattened or used to belittle infertile spouses
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Casti preserves its historical language about matrimonial ends; later magisterial discussions must be reconciled instead of silently made identical.
claims.stage_live_en: Catholic marriage is neither merely reproductive nor merely companionate. It joins faithful spousal love with the generative and educational goods of family life.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le mariage catholique n’est ni purement reproductif ni purement compagnonnique. Il unit l’amour fidèle des époux aux biens génératifs et éducatifs de la vie familiale.

claims.atomic_claim: Protection can justify separation from harmful cohabitation
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Distinguish canonical separation, nullity and dissolution; do not suggest abuse victims must remain with an aggressor.
claims.stage_live_en: Separation can be justified, and civil measures may be necessary to protect spouses, children or property.
claims.stage_live_fr: La séparation peut être justifiée, et des mesures civiles peuvent être nécessaires pour protéger les époux, les enfants ou les biens.

claims.atomic_claim: Ending life together differs from dissolving the matrimonial bond
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Distinguish canonical separation, nullity and dissolution; do not suggest abuse victims must remain with an aggressor.
claims.stage_live_en: Ending common life and dissolving the matrimonial bond are distinct acts. Failure of the relationship does not by itself establish that the covenant has ceased to exist.
claims.stage_live_fr: Mettre fin à la vie commune et dissoudre le lien matrimonial sont deux actes distincts. L’échec de la relation n’établit pas à lui seul que l’alliance a cessé d’exister.

claims.atomic_claim: Can.1141 governs ratified and consummated marriage while other dissolution rules differ
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Distinguish canonical separation, nullity and dissolution; do not suggest abuse victims must remain with an aggressor.
claims.stage_live_en: Christ's command and CIC can. 1141 teach that a valid, ratified and consummated sacramental marriage cannot be dissolved by any human power. This is not an assertion that every valid marriage is equally indissoluble: cann. 1142–1150 govern exceptional dissolutions of certain non-consummated or non-sacramental bonds. Relationship breakdown does not itself dissolve marriage.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le commandement du Christ et le CIC (can. 1141) enseignent qu'un mariage sacramentel valide, ratifié et consommé ne peut être dissous par aucune puissance humaine. Cela ne signifie pas que tout mariage valide soit indissoluble au même degré : les canons 1142–1150 prévoient la dissolution exceptionnelle de certains liens non consommés ou non sacramentels. L'échec de la vie commune ne dissout pas en soi le mariage.

claims.atomic_claim: Can.1153 permits rapid separation for grave danger to spouse or children
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Distinguish canonical separation, nullity and dissolution; do not suggest abuse victims must remain with an aggressor.
claims.stage_live_en: CIC can. 1153 explicitly permits separation where a spouse or child faces grave mental or physical danger, including departure without awaiting a decree if delay poses danger. The duty to preserve a bond must never be confused with a requirement to endure abusive cohabitation.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le CIC (can. 1153) permet expressément la séparation lorsqu'un époux ou un enfant subit un danger grave physique ou psychique, y compris sans attendre de décret si le retard est dangereux. Préserver le lien ne doit jamais être confondu avec l'obligation de subir une cohabitation violente.

claims.atomic_claim: Permanent bond does not require remaining in unsafe cohabitation
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Distinguish canonical separation, nullity and dissolution; do not suggest abuse victims must remain with an aggressor.
claims.stage_live_en: Indissolubility does not mean compulsory cohabitation under every condition. It means that grave failure does not by itself dissolve a valid marital bond.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’indissolubilité ne signifie pas cohabitation obligatoire en toute circonstance. Elle signifie qu’un échec grave ne dissout pas par lui-même un lien matrimonial valide.

claims.atomic_claim: Civil breakdown and suffering of innocent spouses are real
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Nullity and dissolution are separate canonical proceedings, and legal divorce effects vary by jurisdiction.
claims.stage_live_en: Catholic teaching does not deny the injustice or loneliness an innocent spouse may suffer, and it permits separation where necessary.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’enseignement catholique ne nie ni l’injustice ni la solitude que peut subir un conjoint innocent, et il permet la séparation lorsque nécessaire.

claims.atomic_claim: Civil divorce does not necessarily dissolve the sacramental bond
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Nullity and dissolution are separate canonical proceedings, and legal divorce effects vary by jurisdiction.
claims.stage_live_en: A failed common life does not by itself equal a dissolved matrimonial bond; Catholic teaching distinguishes those realities.
claims.stage_live_fr: Une vie commune échouée n’équivaut pas à elle seule à un lien matrimonial dissous ; l’enseignement catholique distingue ces réalités.

claims.atomic_claim: Prior bond, declaration of nullity and exceptional dissolution differ
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Nullity and dissolution are separate canonical proceedings, and legal divorce effects vary by jurisdiction.
claims.stage_live_en: Civil divorce alone does not create freedom to remarry while a prior valid bond persists (CIC can. 1085). Nullity judges that a valid marriage never arose. Separately, canons 1142–1150 permit narrowly limited dissolutions of certain valid but non-consummated or non-sacramental bonds: these are not declarations of nullity.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le divorce civil ne donne pas à lui seul la liberté de se remarier tant qu'un lien valide subsiste (CIC, can. 1085). La nullité constate qu'un mariage valide n'a pas existé dès l'origine. Séparément, les canons 1142–1150 permettent la dissolution très limitée de certains liens valides non consommés ou non sacramentels : ce ne sont pas des déclarations de nullité.

claims.atomic_claim: Civil legal status and canonical bond are not identical
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Nullity and dissolution are separate canonical proceedings, and legal divorce effects vary by jurisdiction.
claims.stage_live_en: No in principle: civil divorce terminates a marriage's civil legal status, but does not by itself dissolve a prior valid sacramental bond; a declaration of nullity judges that a valid bond never arose because an essential requirement was missing. Whether tribunals apply that distinction well in a particular case is a separate question.
claims.stage_live_fr: Non en principe : le divorce civil met fin au statut juridique civil du mariage, mais ne dissout pas, de lui-même, un lien sacramentel valide ; une déclaration de nullité juge qu'aucun lien valide ne s'était formé faute d'une condition essentielle. La question de savoir si les tribunaux appliquent bien cette distinction dans un cas concret est distincte.

claims.atomic_claim: Only legitimately established nullity/dissolution can establish freedom for a new union
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Nullity and dissolution are separate canonical proceedings, and legal divorce effects vary by jurisdiction.
claims.stage_live_en: Marital breakdown alone gives no right to remarry; the actual status of a prior bond must be established. Nullity, separation and exceptional canonical dissolution are distinct matters.
claims.stage_live_fr: L'échec conjugal ne donne pas à lui seul le droit de se remarier ; il faut établir le statut réel du lien antérieur. Nullité, séparation et dissolution canonique exceptionnelle sont des réalités distinctes.

claims.atomic_claim: Marriage permits legitimate conjugal intimacy
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: No comprehensive list of specific sexual techniques or devices is derived from these paragraphs.
claims.stage_live_en: Marriage genuinely changes the moral context of sexual activity, and spouses have a wide sphere of legitimate affection and intimacy.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le mariage change réellement le contexte moral de l’activité sexuelle, et les époux disposent d’un large espace d’affection et d’intimité légitimes.

claims.atomic_claim: Mutual consent does not cancel conjugal fidelity or moral norms
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: No comprehensive list of specific sexual techniques or devices is derived from these paragraphs.
claims.stage_live_en: The inference from “marriage permits sex” to “marriage sanctifies every sexual choice” does not follow. Consent cannot authorize what contradicts fidelity, justice or the integrity of the marital act.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’inférence de « le mariage permet la sexualité » à « le mariage sanctifie tout choix sexuel » ne suit pas. Le consentement ne peut autoriser ce qui contredit la fidélité, la justice ou l’intégrité de l’acte conjugal.

claims.atomic_claim: Spousal fidelity and unitive/procreative integrity remain distinct goods
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: No comprehensive list of specific sexual techniques or devices is derived from these paragraphs.
claims.stage_live_en: Casti Connubii §§19–22 identifies conjugal fidelity as exclusive: marital rights cannot be shared with a third person, and one spouse cannot permit what contradicts divine law. Humanae Vitae §§12–14 further requires respect for the integrity of the conjugal act. Free agreement is necessary but does not convert every choice into a morally conjugal act.
claims.stage_live_fr: Casti Connubii, §§19–22, définit la fidélité conjugale comme exclusive : les droits matrimoniaux ne peuvent être partagés avec un tiers, et un conjoint ne peut permettre ce qui contredit la loi divine. Humanae Vitae, §§12–14, demande également de respecter l’intégrité de l’acte conjugal. L’accord libre est nécessaire, mais il ne transforme pas tout choix en acte conjugal moralement bon.

claims.atomic_claim: Free agreement cannot itself specify a licit moral object
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: No comprehensive list of specific sexual techniques or devices is derived from these paragraphs.
claims.stage_live_en: The same issue as in consent generally: the moral object cannot be reduced to mutual willingness. The act must still be compatible with marital fidelity, chastity and the meaning of conjugal union.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le même problème que pour le consentement en général : l’objet moral ne peut être réduit à la volonté mutuelle. L’acte doit encore être compatible avec la fidélité, la chasteté et la signification de l’union conjugale.

claims.atomic_claim: Marital consent does not permit every sexual arrangement
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: No comprehensive list of specific sexual techniques or devices is derived from these paragraphs.
claims.stage_live_en: Marriage makes conjugal sexuality legitimate; it does not make every consensual sexual choice good.
claims.stage_live_fr: Le mariage rend légitime la sexualité conjugale ; il ne rend pas bon tout choix sexuel consensuel.

claims.atomic_claim: Reciprocal marital duties can exist but do not authorize harm
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Supplement is non-magisterial scholastic casuistry; immediate safety is prior to theoretical disputes about reciprocal obligations.
claims.stage_live_en: Without proportionate reason, persistent refusal of legitimate conjugal relations can sometimes be unjust; the tradition does acknowledge reciprocal duties. But Aquinas himself limits what may be demanded: an exaction against a spouse's bodily welfare is unjust (Supplement, q.64 a.1, reply to objection 2). A moral duty never authorizes force.
claims.stage_live_fr: Sans raison proportionnée, le refus persistant de relations conjugales légitimes peut parfois être injuste ; la tradition reconnaît bien des devoirs réciproques. Cependant, saint Thomas limite lui-même ce qui peut être exigé : une demande contraire à la santé et au bien corporel du conjoint est injuste (Supplément, q.64, a.1, réponse à la deuxième objection). Un devoir moral n'autorise jamais la contrainte.

claims.atomic_claim: An imposed marital act disregarding spouse's reasonable wishes is condemned
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Supplement is non-magisterial scholastic casuistry; immediate safety is prior to theoretical disputes about reciprocal obligations.
claims.stage_live_en: A right to request a marital act is not a right to force one. Moral obligation and coercive entitlement are different concepts.
claims.stage_live_fr: Un droit à demander l’acte conjugal n’est pas un droit à l’imposer par la force. L’obligation morale et le pouvoir coercitif sont des concepts différents.

claims.atomic_claim: Humanae Vitae §13 and CIC 1153 rule out coercion and allow protection
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Supplement is non-magisterial scholastic casuistry; immediate safety is prior to theoretical disputes about reciprocal obligations.
claims.stage_live_en: Conjugal rights do not establish ownership of a spouse's body. Humanae Vitae §13 rejects an imposed act that disregards a spouse's condition and reasonable wishes. Serious coercion or abuse calls for protection and, where needed, separation under CIC can. 1153.
claims.stage_live_fr: Les droits conjugaux ne rendent personne propriétaire du corps de son conjoint. Humanae Vitae (§13) rejette l'acte imposé sans égard à l'état et aux désirs légitimes de l'époux. Une contrainte grave ou des violences justifient la recherche d'une protection et, si nécessaire, la séparation prévue au CIC (can. 1153).

claims.atomic_claim: The injustice of coercion must not be recast as a mere marital disagreement
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Supplement is non-magisterial scholastic casuistry; immediate safety is prior to theoretical disputes about reciprocal obligations.
claims.stage_live_en: Yes. It means spouses should not treat sexuality as purely individual property or use refusal manipulatively. But a moral duty is fulfilled through free human action, not violence or domination.
claims.stage_live_fr: Oui. Cela signifie que les époux ne doivent pas traiter la sexualité comme une propriété purement individuelle ni utiliser le refus comme moyen de manipulation. Mais un devoir moral s’accomplit par un acte humain libre, non par violence ou domination.

claims.atomic_claim: Marriage gives no enforceable right to forced sexual contact
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Supplement is non-magisterial scholastic casuistry; immediate safety is prior to theoretical disputes about reciprocal obligations.
claims.stage_live_en: Marital rights are real and reciprocal; coercion is not one of those rights.
claims.stage_live_fr: Les droits matrimoniaux sont réels et réciproques ; la coercition n’en fait pas partie.

claims.atomic_claim: Spacing or postponing pregnancy can be justified for serious reasons
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: HV §15 specifically protects legitimate therapeutic treatment with unintended sterility; no claim that all medical interventions are illicit.
claims.stage_live_en: Responsible parenthood can require postponing pregnancy, sometimes for a long period.
claims.stage_live_fr: La responsabilité parentale peut exiger de différer une grossesse, parfois longtemps.

claims.atomic_claim: Intentional contraception differs from merely treating medical disease
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: HV §15 specifically protects legitimate therapeutic treatment with unintended sterility; no claim that all medical interventions are illicit.
claims.stage_live_en: Criticism of a merely biological analysis does not establish that deliberately contracepted intercourse has a good moral object. Intentionally frustrating the procreative meaning of the chosen conjugal act remains morally distinct from treating an illness or refraining from intercourse.
claims.stage_live_fr: Critiquer une analyse purement biologique ne démontre pas que contracepter délibérément l’union possède un objet moral bon. Frustrer intentionnellement la signification procréatrice de l’acte conjugal choisi reste moralement distinct du traitement d’une maladie ou de l’abstinence.

claims.atomic_claim: Casti and Humanae Vitae condemn directly rendering conjugal intercourse infertile
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: HV §15 specifically protects legitimate therapeutic treatment with unintended sterility; no claim that all medical interventions are illicit.
claims.stage_live_en: Casti Connubii §§53–56 condemns deliberately frustrating the generative capacity of marital intercourse. Humanae Vitae §§11–14 explains this through the relationship between the unitive and procreative meanings and specifies contraception as an action intended to prevent procreation, as an end or a means. The claim therefore concerns the deliberate choice, not the proposition that every biological intervention is immoral.
claims.stage_live_fr: Casti Connubii, §§53–56, condamne la frustration délibérée de la faculté génératrice de l’union conjugale. Humanae Vitae, §§11–14, explicite le rapport entre ses significations unitive et procréatrice et qualifie de contraception l’action destinée à empêcher la procréation comme fin ou comme moyen. L’argument porte donc sur le choix délibéré, non sur l’idée que toute intervention biologique serait immorale.

claims.atomic_claim: Serious family circumstances cannot change the moral object of contraception
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: HV §15 specifically protects legitimate therapeutic treatment with unintended sterility; no claim that all medical interventions are illicit.
claims.stage_live_en: Contraception involves the deliberate choice to suppress the procreative meaning of intercourse, not merely an intervention in a biological process (Humanae Vitae §§12–14). The spouses' broader circumstances remain morally relevant, but a serious reason to avoid pregnancy does not in itself make deliberate contraception lawful.
claims.stage_live_fr: La contraception implique le choix délibéré de supprimer la signification procréatrice de l’union, et non une simple intervention sur un processus biologique (Humanae Vitae, §§12–14). Les circonstances des époux gardent leur importance morale, mais une raison grave d’éviter une grossesse ne rend pas pour autant la contraception licite.

claims.atomic_claim: The question is not whether birth spacing is sometimes responsible
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: HV §15 specifically protects legitimate therapeutic treatment with unintended sterility; no claim that all medical interventions are illicit.
claims.stage_live_en: The controversy is not whether avoiding pregnancy can be responsible. It is whether deliberately contracepting intercourse is a morally neutral means of doing so.
claims.stage_live_fr: La controverse ne porte pas sur le fait qu’éviter une grossesse puisse être responsable. Elle porte sur la question de savoir si contracepter délibérément l’union est un moyen moralement neutre.

claims.atomic_claim: A couple avoiding conception may have the same further intention in both methods
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Pius XII's rights-versus-exercise distinction concerns valid consent, not simply a modern efficiency calculation for natural family planning.
claims.stage_live_en: NFP is not morally different because its users secretly want pregnancy. They may very clearly intend to avoid it.
claims.stage_live_fr: La PFN n’est pas moralement différente parce que ses utilisateurs voudraient secrètement une grossesse. Ils peuvent très clairement vouloir l’éviter.

claims.atomic_claim: Different chosen means can carry different moral objects
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Pius XII's rights-versus-exercise distinction concerns valid consent, not simply a modern efficiency calculation for natural family planning.
claims.stage_live_en: The missing distinction is between the further intention and the act chosen as the means. Same end does not make different means the same moral act.
claims.stage_live_fr: La distinction manquante est celle entre l’intention ultérieure et l’acte choisi comme moyen. Une même fin ne rend pas des moyens différents moralement identiques.

claims.atomic_claim: Pius XII's rights versus exercise distinction and HV §16 govern periodic abstinence
claims.passage_locator: 1951 address on diritto matrimoniale and its use
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Pius XII's rights-versus-exercise distinction concerns valid consent, not simply a modern efficiency calculation for natural family planning.
claims.stage_live_en: Periodic continence refrains from intercourse during fertile periods; contraception deliberately frustrates the procreative capacity of intercourse that is performed. Pius XII's 1951 address distinguishes the use of matrimonial rights from the rights themselves and requires sufficiently serious reasons for a settled restriction to infertile periods. Humanae Vitae §16 separately confirms that avoiding pregnancy can be intended in both cases without making their chosen means morally identical.
claims.stage_live_fr: La continence périodique consiste à s'abstenir pendant les périodes fertiles ; la contraception frustre délibérément la capacité procréatrice d'un acte conjugal accompli. Dans son allocution de 1951, Pie XII distingue l'usage des droits conjugaux des droits eux-mêmes et exige des motifs moralement suffisants pour limiter durablement les rapports aux périodes infécondes. Humanae Vitae (§16) confirme que l'intention d'éviter une grossesse peut être présente dans les deux cas, sans rendre identiques les moyens choisis.

claims.atomic_claim: Avoiding intercourse differs from contracepting an intercourse act
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Pius XII's rights-versus-exercise distinction concerns valid consent, not simply a modern efficiency calculation for natural family planning.
claims.stage_live_en: Refraining from an act and performing it while altering it are not identical choices merely because they serve the same goal. Moral reasoning makes that distinction elsewhere as well. Moreover, periodic abstinence is not automatically virtuous: using it for selfish or disproportionate reasons can itself be morally defective.
claims.stage_live_fr: S’abstenir d’un acte et l’accomplir tout en le modifiant ne sont pas des choix identiques simplement parce qu’ils servent la même fin. Le raisonnement moral fait cette distinction ailleurs aussi. De plus, la continence périodique n’est pas automatiquement vertueuse : l’employer pour des raisons égoïstes ou disproportionnées peut elle-même être moralement défectueuse.

claims.atomic_claim: Use of infertile periods must still have justifying circumstances
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Pius XII's rights-versus-exercise distinction concerns valid consent, not simply a modern efficiency calculation for natural family planning.
claims.stage_live_en: Same intention does not mean same act. The Catholic distinction concerns what the couple chooses to do to the marital act itself.
claims.stage_live_fr: Même intention ne signifie pas même acte. La distinction catholique porte sur ce que le couple choisit de faire à l’acte conjugal lui-même.

claims.atomic_claim: Selfish motives can corrupt a materially different abstinence method
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The legal/contractual analysis is historical Pius XII text; do not flatten it into modern claims about all infertility planning.
claims.stage_live_en: NFP can be used with a contraceptive mentality in the ordinary-language sense of selfishly refusing parenthood. Catholic teaching does not declare every use of periodic abstinence virtuous.
claims.stage_live_fr: La PFN peut être utilisée avec une mentalité contraceptive au sens courant d’un refus égoïste de la parentalité. L’enseignement catholique ne déclare pas vertueux tout usage de la continence périodique.

claims.atomic_claim: Intention alone is not the technical definition of contraception
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The legal/contractual analysis is historical Pius XII text; do not flatten it into modern claims about all infertility planning.
claims.stage_live_en: But the technical moral meaning of contraception concerns the act chosen, not merely the wish to avoid a child. Periodic abstinence does not render an act infertile; it chooses when not to perform the act.
claims.stage_live_fr: Mais le sens moral technique de la contraception concerne l’acte choisi, non le seul désir d’éviter un enfant. La continence périodique ne rend pas un acte infécond ; elle choisit quand ne pas accomplir l’acte.

claims.atomic_claim: Pius XII differentiates withholding the right from limiting its exercise
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The legal/contractual analysis is historical Pius XII text; do not flatten it into modern claims about all infertility planning.
claims.stage_live_en: Pius XII permitted recourse to infertile periods for sufficiently serious reasons while rejecting direct contraception. He also distinguished voluntarily limiting the use of conjugal rights from excluding those rights in matrimonial consent; the latter could invalidate the marriage. Humanae Vitae §16 retains the separate distinction between periodic abstinence and deliberately contracepted intercourse.
claims.stage_live_fr: Pie XII permettait le recours aux périodes infécondes pour des motifs moralement suffisants tout en rejetant la contraception directe. Il distinguait aussi la limitation volontaire de l'usage des droits conjugaux de leur exclusion dans le consentement matrimonial, laquelle pouvait invalider le mariage. Humanae Vitae (§16) maintient la distinction entre abstinence périodique et rapport conjugal délibérément contraceptif.

claims.atomic_claim: The choice to abstain differs from direct contraception
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The legal/contractual analysis is historical Pius XII text; do not flatten it into modern claims about all infertility planning.
claims.stage_live_en: Only if moral object is reduced to anatomy. The claim is about what the will chooses to do: abstain, or perform intercourse while deliberately suppressing its fertility. That is an intentional difference, not merely a physical one.
claims.stage_live_fr: Seulement si l’objet moral est réduit à l’anatomie. L’affirmation porte sur ce que la volonté choisit de faire : s’abstenir, ou accomplir l’union tout en supprimant délibérément sa fécondité. C’est une différence intentionnelle, non seulement physique.

claims.atomic_claim: The acts cannot be equated merely because children are not desired
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The legal/contractual analysis is historical Pius XII text; do not flatten it into modern claims about all infertility planning.
claims.stage_live_en: NFP can be used badly, but it is not contraception in the Catholic moral sense because the chosen means is different.
claims.stage_live_fr: La PFN peut être mal utilisée, mais elle n’est pas une contraception au sens moral catholique parce que le moyen choisi est différent.

claims.atomic_claim: Responsibility differs for choosing and reluctantly tolerating contraception
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The papal exception is bounded by its actual words and does not pre-authorize every modern coercive situation.
claims.stage_live_en: The spouses’ responsibility is not automatically identical. The one who chooses contraception bears a responsibility the reluctant spouse may not share.
claims.stage_live_fr: La responsabilité des époux n’est pas automatiquement identique. Celui qui choisit la contraception porte une responsabilité que le conjoint réticent peut ne pas partager.

claims.atomic_claim: Tolerance of another's wrong differs from approval of it
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The papal exception is bounded by its actual words and does not pre-authorize every modern coercive situation.
claims.stage_live_en: The mistake is assuming that any participation equals approval. Moral cooperation depends on intention, what each spouse actually chooses, and what can reasonably be avoided.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’erreur est de supposer que toute participation équivaut à une approbation. La coopération morale dépend de l’intention, de ce que chacun choisit réellement et de ce qui peut raisonnablement être évité.

claims.atomic_claim: Casti §59 sets grave reason, reluctance and charitable dissuasion conditions
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The papal exception is bounded by its actual words and does not pre-authorize every modern coercive situation.
claims.stage_live_en: Casti Connubii §59 distinguishes the spouse choosing contraception from one who, for a grave reason, reluctantly tolerates what is not approved. The latter must not choose contraception and must not neglect charitable efforts to dissuade the partner. The passage concerns responsibility in a constrained situation, not permission to contracept.
claims.stage_live_fr: Casti Connubii (§59) distingue le conjoint qui choisit la contraception de celui qui, pour une raison grave, tolère à regret ce qu'il n'approuve pas. Celui-ci ne doit ni choisir la contraception ni négliger de chercher charitablement à en détourner l'autre. Ce texte traite de la responsabilité en situation contrainte, non d'une permission de contracepter.

claims.atomic_claim: The non-choosing spouse's situation does not license contraceptive acts
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The papal exception is bounded by its actual words and does not pre-authorize every modern coercive situation.
claims.stage_live_en: No. The exception concerns the responsibility of the non-choosing spouse, not the moral goodness of contraception. Grave reasons, reluctance and absence of approval matter; the contraceptive act itself is not reclassified as good.
claims.stage_live_fr: Non. L’exception concerne la responsabilité du conjoint qui ne choisit pas, non la bonté morale de la contraception. Les raisons graves, la réticence et l’absence d’approbation comptent ; l’acte contraceptif lui-même n’est pas reclassé comme bon.

claims.atomic_claim: Material cooperation is not exhaustively settled by one paragraph
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The papal exception is bounded by its actual words and does not pre-authorize every modern coercive situation.
claims.stage_live_en: Grave reason, reluctant toleration and charitable efforts to dissuade the partner are integral to Casti Connubii §59. The passage does not declare contraception good or resolve every case of material cooperation.
claims.stage_live_fr: La raison grave, la tolérance à regret et le devoir charitable de détourner l'autre sont constitutifs de Casti Connubii (§59). Ce passage ne rend pas la contraception bonne et ne règle pas tous les cas de coopération matérielle.

claims.atomic_claim: Many medical treatments restoring fertility are permitted
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Reject the chosen IVF technique, not the child; medical claims about current IVF success or embryo losses need separate current evidence.
claims.stage_live_en: Catholic teaching explicitly permits many treatments that restore fertility or assist the marital act. It does not reject technology as such.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’enseignement catholique permet explicitement de nombreux traitements qui restaurent la fertilité ou assistent l’acte conjugal. Il ne rejette pas la technologie en tant que telle.

claims.atomic_claim: Assistance to the conjugal act differs from substituting for it
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Reject the chosen IVF technique, not the child; medical claims about current IVF success or embryo losses need separate current evidence.
claims.stage_live_en: The crucial distinction is between assisting the spouses’ own conjugal act and replacing it as the cause of conception.
claims.stage_live_fr: La distinction décisive est celle entre assister l’acte conjugal propre aux époux et le remplacer comme cause de la conception.

claims.atomic_claim: Homologous IVF remains rejected even in the no-embryo-loss hypothetical
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Reject the chosen IVF technique, not the child; medical claims about current IVF success or embryo losses need separate current evidence.
claims.stage_live_en: Donum Vitae II.B.5 rejects homologous IVF even where embryo destruction and masturbation are excluded, because conception through the laboratory replaces rather than assists the spouses' conjugal act. Dignitas Personae §§12–13 affirm fertility-restoring treatments and techniques that assist that act; §§14–16 separately address embryo destruction and the separation of procreation from conjugal self-giving. None of this diminishes the dignity of any child conceived through IVF.
claims.stage_live_fr: Donum Vitae (II.B.5) rejette la FIV homologue même lorsque la destruction d'embryons et la masturbation sont exclues, parce que la conception en laboratoire remplace l'acte conjugal des époux au lieu de l'assister. Dignitas Personae (§§12–13) admet les traitements restaurant la fécondité et les techniques qui assistent cet acte ; les §§14–16 examinent séparément la destruction des embryons et la dissociation de la procréation d'avec le don conjugal. Rien de cela ne diminue la dignité d'un enfant conçu par FIV.

claims.atomic_claim: Legitimate desire for a child cannot validate every means
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Reject the chosen IVF technique, not the child; medical claims about current IVF success or embryo losses need separate current evidence.
claims.stage_live_en: The legitimate desire for a child does not make every means morally interchangeable. The Church permits technology that repairs infertility or assists the spouses' own act, but rejects producing the child through a procedure that replaces that act (Dignitas Personae §§12–16).
claims.stage_live_fr: Le désir légitime d'un enfant ne rend pas tous les moyens moralement équivalents. L'Église admet la technique qui soigne l'infertilité ou aide l'acte des époux, mais refuse la production de l'enfant par un procédé qui remplace cet acte (Dignitas Personae, §§12–16).

claims.atomic_claim: Children conceived through IVF retain undiminished dignity
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: Reject the chosen IVF technique, not the child; medical claims about current IVF success or embryo losses need separate current evidence.
claims.stage_live_en: IVF is not rejected out of hostility to children or medicine. The moral concerns are the substitution of technique for the conjugal act and, often, additional wrongs toward embryos.
claims.stage_live_fr: La FIV n’est rejetée ni par hostilité envers les enfants ni envers la médecine. Les difficultés morales concernent la substitution de la technique à l’acte conjugal et, souvent, des torts supplémentaires envers les embryons.

claims.atomic_claim: Compassionate infertility motives can be real
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The document defines historical surrogate scenarios; later variants, custody arrangements and empirical effects require case-specific analysis.
claims.stage_live_en: The good intention of helping an infertile couple can be real. Payment is not the sole issue, and even a well-safeguarded unpaid arrangement requires examining the intentional separation of gestation, birth and upbringing.
claims.stage_live_fr: La bonne intention d’aider un couple infertile peut être réelle. La rémunération n’est pas le seul enjeu et, même avec des garanties dans un arrangement bénévole, il reste à examiner la séparation intentionnelle entre gestation, naissance et éducation.

claims.atomic_claim: Payment is not the exclusive moral criterion for surrogate gestation
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The document defines historical surrogate scenarios; later variants, custody arrangements and empirical effects require case-specific analysis.
claims.stage_live_en: The inference is that absence of payment removes every moral issue. Surrogacy also deliberately separates gestation from the woman who will rear the child and subjects pregnancy to an agreement that the child will be handed over.
claims.stage_live_fr: L’inférence est que l’absence de paiement supprime tout problème moral. La gestation pour autrui sépare aussi délibérément la grossesse de la femme qui élèvera l’enfant et soumet la grossesse à un accord prévoyant la remise de l’enfant.

claims.atomic_claim: Donum Vitae II.A.3 rejects surrogate motherhood as splitting parental obligations
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The document defines historical surrogate scenarios; later variants, custody arrangements and empirical effects require case-specific analysis.
claims.stage_live_en: Donum Vitae II.A.3 rejects surrogate motherhood regardless of payment because the procreative plan deliberately separates gestation, birth, and the obligations of maternal love and marital fidelity. The moral objection is therefore not confined to commercialization or demonstrable coercion, even when an infertile couple's desire and a carrier's generosity are sincere.
claims.stage_live_fr: Donum Vitae (II.A.3) rejette la maternité de substitution indépendamment de toute rémunération, parce que le projet de procréation sépare volontairement la gestation, la naissance et les devoirs de l'amour maternel et de la fidélité conjugale. L'objection morale ne se limite donc pas au commerce ou à une coercition prouvée, même si le désir du couple infertile et la générosité de la femme porteuse sont sincères.

claims.atomic_claim: Adoption and planned gestational separation are different situations
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The document defines historical surrogate scenarios; later variants, custody arrangements and empirical effects require case-specific analysis.
claims.stage_live_en: Adoption provides a family for a child already needing one; surrogacy makes the planned separation of gestation and parental upbringing part of how a child is brought into being. The intentions can both be generous, but these are morally different chosen acts.
claims.stage_live_fr: L'adoption accueille un enfant ayant déjà besoin d'une famille ; la maternité de substitution prévoit dès la conception la séparation entre gestation et éducation parentale. Les intentions peuvent être généreuses dans les deux cas, mais les actes librement choisis diffèrent moralement.

claims.atomic_claim: Altruism does not alone cure separation of gestation and family obligations
claims.source_to_claim_boundary: The document defines historical surrogate scenarios; later variants, custody arrangements and empirical effects require case-specific analysis.
claims.stage_live_en: Altruistic motive can remove commercial exploitation, but it does not remove the intentional fragmentation of gestation, motherhood and parenthood.
claims.stage_live_fr: Un motif altruiste peut supprimer l’exploitation commerciale, mais il ne supprime pas la fragmentation intentionnelle de la gestation, de la maternité et de la parentalité.
